objective: One clean production flow with explicitly independent subsystems

market.rule: Odds/popularity may affect only value and purchase judgement after prediction seal; never pure ability ranking.

validation.rule: Validation uses leakage-safe ledgers and cannot write into live prediction outputs.

model_certification.rule: Golden-case parity and leakage checks are independent from race-day operation.

site_dictionary.rule: Terminology generation never changes horse ranking or betting logic.

emergency_repair.rule: Manual-only repair path; not part of normal production sequence.

retired_workflow_policy: Historical experiments, one-off diagnostics, backfills and V2-V14 replay calibration workflows live in .github/workflow-archive and cannot trigger automatically.
no_mix_rules: PURE_PREDICTION must not read odds, popularity, payout or target result fields.
MARKET_EV_GATE must not rewrite pure prediction rankings.
RESULT_INGEST starts only after races complete and must not modify sealed historical predictions.
MODEL_VALIDATION must remain separate from production writes.
SITE_DICTIONARY and SITE_DEPLOY must remain separate from racing model state.

ui_constitution.rule: User-visible display format must never be changed without an explicit user instruction requesting that specific UI/format change.
allowed_without_explicit_user_instructio: bug fixes that preserve the existing display format
backend/data-source changes that preserve the existing display format
prohibited_without_explicit_user_instruc: replacing an existing interaction with a different interaction
simplifying or expanding the visible format
ui_constitution.replay_generation_rule: docs/replay/index.html must be generated from src/build_replay_page.py; normal fixes change the canonical generator/data source, not the generated HTML.

repair_constitution.rule: For defects, identify and correct the root cause in the canonical owner. Do not stack compensating code on top of broken or duplicated paths when the existing structure can be simplified.
required_sequence: trace to canonical source and owner
run architecture and affected workflow checks
only use additive compatibility patches when structural correction is unsafe or impossible
prohibited: duplicate functions for the same responsibility
two active workflows owning the same write responsibility
direct edits to generated artifacts as a normal repair method
temporary date-specific production logic when a generic path is available
declaring completion from a deploy log alone when user-visible behavior has not been verified
